neighbours.label: the word before 'home'/'ease' in comfort idioms ('feel right at home', 'feel at ease', 'feel most comfortable'), predicting 'home'
fire: The cozy lobby makes travelers feel right at home after a long trip.
Our goal is that new students feel at home in the dorms.
The friendly staff made my grandmother feel at ease during the visit.
He seemed perfectly at home on the stage of the old theater.
Visitors to the farm say they feel completely at home there.
The soft lighting helps patients feel more at ease in the clinic.
After a week the puppy was already at home in our kitchen.
She always felt most at home among the books of the library.
quiet: The cozy lobby has travelers arrive right at noon after a long trip.
Our goal is that new students arrive at eight in the dorms.
The friendly staff met my grandmother at the door during the visit.
He seemed to arrive at the stage of the old theater early.
Visitors to the farm say they look at the cows there.
The soft lighting helps patients read at night in the clinic.
After a week the puppy was already at the vet in town.
She always sat at the desk among the books of the library.
